attempts.summary: Configured VRRP-based active/backup failover for a shared VIP (10.100.146.100/24) between node1 and node2 (both OpenWrt, on the same L2 network as node3) using keepalived, persisted through OpenWrt's UCI/procd service management. Demonstrated node3 maintaining uninterrupted reachability to the VIP across a live master failover (zero packet loss across 67 consecutive pings while node1's keepalived was stopped and node2 took over) and preemption back to node1. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: each of node1, node2, node3 was restarted one at a time via native `reboot`, polled back to availability, and shown to have a new boot_id and reset uptime, with keepalived/VIP/network state verified healthy after each restart. During node1's own restart, the VIP failover to node2 was also verified live with continued node3 reachability.
